title: Indianapolis Colts vs. Washington Commanders: EdgeDesk Model Projection, Matchup Analysis and Fair Spread
seo_title: Indianapolis Colts vs. Washington Commanders 2026: EdgeDesk Fair Spread & Model Projection
seo_description: EdgeDesk prices Indianapolis Colts at Washington Commanders at Washington Commanders +1.3 with a 50.2 fair total. Indianapolis Colts wins 55% of simulations. Model status INVESTIGATE. Research, not picks.
excerpt: Indianapolis Colts carries the stronger EdgeDesk offensive profile (#12 in EPA per play) and the better defensive rating with it, so the ratings point the same way on both sides of the ball. EdgeDesk’s independent projection makes it Washington Commanders…
model_status_note: EdgeDesk differs from the market by 3.2 points. That is enough to look harder — and out of sample no gap size of any width has cleared p<0.05 against the close, so it is a research prompt and not an edge.
author: EdgeDesk Research
research_source: Ratings: EdgeDesk’s NFL rating state — trained seeds through 2025 plus 31 absorbed 2026 games, opponent-adjusted from the public nflverse team-week feed. Projection: the same edgedesk_football_v1.0.0 call the game card makes. Nothing on this page was computed in your browser twice.

lede: Indianapolis Colts carries the stronger EdgeDesk offensive profile (#12 in EPA per play) and the better defensive rating with it, so the ratings point the same way on both sides of the ball.
EdgeDesk’s independent projection makes it Washington Commanders +1.3 with a fair total of 50.2 — approximately a one-score game, before any sportsbook number is consulted.

The widest measured matchup on the board is Indianapolis Colts run offence vs Washington Commanders run defence, which sits +0.158 from the league mean once the two ratings are combined the way the model combines them.
The largest uncertainty is availability: NFL injury report — not loaded in this session.

score.note: Split from EdgeDesk’s own fair spread and fair total, rounded to whole points. It is the centre of a distribution, not a prediction of the exact score.

outcome_range.note: Quoted from the perspective of Washington Commanders, off the engine’s own learned margin distribution (conditioned on this spread, so real key-number mass is kept). Eight results in ten land inside p10–p90.

projection.confidence_absent_reason: The NFL model publishes no single confidence score. What it publishes instead is the width of the outcome range above and the sample the ratings rest on: the trained seeds through 2025, plus 31 absorbed 2026 games.
projection.status_note: EdgeDesk differs from the market by 3.2 points. That is enough to look harder — and out of sample no gap size of any width has cleared p<0.05 against the close, so it is a research prompt and not an edge.
projection.validation: UNPROVEN — this model does NOT beat the closing line out of sample. Research only; nothing here is graded as a bet.
